EmailTemplate.description: QCC: Contact centre compliment request email template will be sent 2pm the following day when the request was raised. CRM-8664
EmailTemplate.name: QCC_Contact_Centre_Letter_2C
EmailTemplate.subject: Qantas Customer Care - {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Ref No: {!Case.CaseNumber}
Dear {!Case.Contact}
Thank you so much for taking the time to let us know about your experience with our Contact Centre staff. Your kind words are very much appreciated.
When travelling, it's nice to know you're not alone and at Qantas we are committed to giving you the best service and support via our 24/7 global Contact Centres. The team work hard to provide a great booking experience and will be delighted to read your feedback. I’ve sent a copy of your comments to pass on to them.
We are grateful for your ongoing support and look forward to welcoming you aboard again soon.
Kind regards
Qantas Customer Care
Note: This email was sent from a notification only address that cannot accept incoming email. Please do not reply to this message.
